note: K1407 c1 bar exceptions: spots where form B (the census reference) is known wrong against Levi's bar (K1315: no ink past the over thread's outline, no dot, no stub). A census find of a listed kind within r of a listed spot is a difference from form B that the bar wants, so k1407c1_bar.ps1 counts it apart. Sheets: out/c1/c1_sheet_fixed.png (master gf | c1 gf | form B | rp=outline).
